messages:
sara: Quick sync — we need to finalize the design-partner success rubric + eviction policy by EOD Fri. My straw: three gating signals (engagement, quality/regression, contract/comms).

aj: +1. Can you propose thresholds? e.g., engagement = >=3 sessions/week or 25 tokens/day?

sara: Thinking engagement = 3 product sessions/week OR 30 total API calls/week. Quality = no more than 3% failing eval regressions across our core prompt set. Comms = NDA signed + biweekly feedback commitment.

nora: I like the triples. For quality, we should weight regressions by severity. Low = cosmetic, Medium = hallucination, High = data-leak. High should trigger immediate escalation.

ben: Suggest a 7-day grace window after an update before applying eviction. Also add a "rehabilitation" path: if user drops then re-engages with 2 consecutive good weeks, they stay.

lex: Legal check — make sure the eviction notice includes the allowed data export and retention options. Ops: can we automate notices? @ops-bot

ops-bot: reminder: deployment window for beta changes scheduled Thu 18:00 UTC. Auto-notify flow template available at /ops/templates/beta-eviction-msg.md

aj: For alerting, I'll write an alert runbook: thresholds, who to ping, templated Slack DM and email. Also add a rollout flag `dp_eviction_v1` behind FF.

sara: sample gating snippet for the dashboard (very small):
```
{
  "engagement": {"min_sessions_week": 3, "min_api_calls_week": 30},
  "quality": {"eval_regression_pct": 3, "severity_weights": {"low":1,"med":5,"high":20}},
  "comms": {"nda_signed": true, "feedback_commitment_weeks": 2}
}
```

nora: Nice. Can we also capture qualitative feedback volume? e.g., at least 1 structured eval + 1 freeform note every 2 weeks. That helps detect silent churn.

ben: Ops question — if someone is evicted, do we archive their data and preserve access for 30 days? Lex?

lex: Yes, archive for 30 days by default; include KMS key-handling note for private customers. I'll draft the legal blurb.

aj: I'll own the runbook. @sara please own the dashboard tile and the rollout FF. @nora will own the structured eval template. @lex to draft legal language. Ben to confirm retention behavior with infra.

sara: Great — targets: runbook + eval template + dashboard tile + legal blurb by EOD Fri. Quick poll: thumbs if you can make that. :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:

nora: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup: (will confirm infra retention by Thu morning)

lex: :thumbsup: will share draft legal blurb by Thu end

sara: Cool. Follow-ups: I'll open the beta-ops ticket and add the FF. Will post updates here. Thanks all.
